partnership_announcements.description: Saudi Energy signed a storage services agreement with Saudi Electricity Company for the Kahafah battery energy storage system.

press_references.value: SE and Kraken Establish Joint Venture to Accelerate Digital Transformation of Utilities and Support the Energy Transition in MENA

partnership_announcements.description: Saudi Energy and Kraken Technologies signed definitive agreements for a strategic partnership and joint venture in Riyadh, making the JV the exclusive reseller of Kraken’s AI-powered utility operating system across MENA and reserving rights to deploy it for 11.5 million SE customer accounts.

press_references.value: Saudi Electricity seals ECA deal for $1.4bln Rabigh 1 power plant expansion

partnership_announcements.description: Saudi Electricity Company signed a 25-year Energy Conversion Agreement with Saudi Power Procurement Company for power offtake from the Rabigh 1 Expansion CCGT plant.

press_references.value: SEC, GE Vernova, Bpifrance sign $3bln pact to boost energy projects

partnership_announcements.description: Saudi Electricity Company entered a tri-party strategic MoU with Bpifrance and GE Vernova to facilitate up to $3 billion in financing for advanced energy and grid projects supporting Saudi Arabia’s clean energy transition.

press_references.value: Saudi Electricity inks $3.4bln deals for two CCGT power plants

partnership_announcements.description: Saudi Electricity Company signed SAR12.8 billion ($3.4B) power purchase agreements with Saudi Power Procurement Company for two Riyadh CCGT plants (PP13 and PP14, 1,678 MW each; 3,356 MW total), including 21-year ownership and operation terms with financial impact starting 2025.

press_references.value: SEC signs MoU with India’s NTPC to establish power plant services company

partnership_announcements.description: Saudi Electricity Company and NTPC signed a strategic MoU to establish a joint venture for power plant services in the Middle East, covering O&M, upgrades, procurement, engineering, project management, and R&D collaboration.

press_references.value: Saudi Electricity Signs SAR13 Billion Power Purchase Agreement for Gas-fired Power Plant

partnership_announcements.description: Power purchase agreement for a gas-fired power plant.

press_references.value: SEC, Acwa Power, Kepco sign $4bln Saudi power purchase deal

partnership_announcements.description: Saudi Electricity Company, Acwa Power, and Kepco signed a $4 billion Power Purchase Agreement with Saudi Power Procurement Company for two power generation projects in Saudi Arabia.

about_short_description.short_description: Saudi Electricity Company (SEC abbreviated or SECO) is a Saudi Arabian power company headquartered in Riyadh.

product.name: Electricity Generation
product.description: Production of electrical power through various energy sources to supply the national grid.

product.name: Electricity Transmission
product.description: High-voltage transmission of electricity from power plants to distribution networks across Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Electricity Distribution
product.description: Delivery of electrical power from transmission substations to end consumers including homes and businesses.

product.name: Customer Services
product.description: Services related to electricity subscription, billing, and customer support for electricity consumers.

product.name: Safety and Incident Reporting
product.description: Mechanism for reporting electrical safety issues, equipment hazards, and other related incidents.
